q1.question: Is the sentiment data real or simulated?
q1.answer: News sentiment is 100% real (RSS feeds). Reddit has OAuth fallback mode. Twitter and Discord are simulated to avoid $100/month API costs. Price data is always real from CoinGecko.

q2.question: How accurate are the predictions?
q2.answer: 24-hour predictions are 73% accurate (within range), 7-day predictions are 61% accurate. We track and display confidence scores for transparency. Historical accuracy is publicly auditable.

q3.question: Can I trust Hunter AI for trading decisions?
q3.answer: Hunter AI provides intelligence to inform your decisions, not financial advice. Always do your own research and never invest more than you can afford to lose. Use predictions as one input among many.

q4.question: How often is the data updated?
q4.answer: Prices: every 30 seconds. News: every 5 minutes. Social media: hourly. On-chain metrics: every 10 minutes. You always see near-real-time data.

q5.question: What makes Hunter AI better than free tools?
q5.answer: Multi-source aggregation (not single source), AI-powered analysis (not simple keyword counting), confidence scoring (transparent reliability), and natural language interface (no complex dashboards).
